sandbachFocus: Sandbach United maintained their position atop the First Division South with a commanding 1-0 home victory over Bilston Town on Saturday. The win extends their remarkable league form to six consecutive victories—the most recent four of which have been wins with just one draw before that. Currently sitting on 31 points from 13 games, Sandbach remain clear leaders and continue to demonstrate the consistency that has defined their season.
divisionWide: Bilston Town, despite the loss to Sandbach, remain in second place with 26 points and showed resilience with five consecutive wins before this setback. Stafford Town drew with Brereton Social and hold third on 25 points, while Wolverhampton Casuals also sit level on points in fourth after their fixture against Telford Town. AFC Bridgnorth, in fifth with 24 points, continue their unbeaten run with a win over Barnton. Barnton themselves are sixth and have won their last four league games. Eccleshall drew with Crewe and hold seventh position. Allscott Heath notched a win against Foley Meir to sit eighth, keeping up their recent four-game winning streak. Lower down, Shawbury United face a crisis period having lost five of their last six league matches, while Alsager Town are in severe form trouble with six consecutive defeats. Widnes Town's poor season continued with a loss to Dawley Town. New Mills drew with Alsager Town, and Cheadle Heath Nomads drew with Shawbury United. Market Drayton Town's match against Wednesfield Community concluded without significant movement for either side in the lower half.
